title: Coverage map
description: The taxonomy grid and what occupies each cell. Empty cells are candidate gaps — but an empty cell has two explanations, and separating them is the whole game.

axes.description: Copied verbatim from protocol.yml. If these differ from protocol.yml the taxonomy was built post-hoc and the empty cells are artifacts.

coords.description: One entry per axis, keyed by axis name.

occupants.description: corpus.jsonl keys landing in this cell.

state.description: An empty cell is NOT automatically a gap, and 'empty because people stopped' has two opposite readings. `unexplored` = nobody tried. `abandoned` = tried, results did not hold up, the field moved on — a warning. `avoided` = the field keeps naming it as an open problem and nobody attempts it, usually because it is hard — often the highest-value target, not a warning. `undecided` = empty and not yet discriminated, the honest default.

trend_evidence.description: The readout that discriminated this cell. For unexplored vs abandoned: neighbours high-volume and growing means unexplored; neighbours peaked years ago means the work stopped. For abandoned vs avoided: count papers naming this as future work or a known limitation without attempting it. Repeated over years with no attempts is `avoided`.

gap_id.description: Set when this cell was promoted to a candidate gap in gaps.yml.

revivable_by.description: For an `abandoned` cell whose failure is attributed to a specific tool or method: the corpus.jsonl key of the documented successor technique that lifts the blocker. Must be a real corpus key — rs_validate checks. Non-null makes the cell promotable to a gap (the 'newly possible' shape, the highest-odds opening on the grid); null keeps `abandoned` unpromoted, so a dead end is never optimistically relabelled.

recall_diagnostic.description: Self-check written in Phase 4. If citation_chain contributed near zero, keyword search was doing all the work and recall is probably bad.

includes_by_mode.description: Includes surfaced by each recall mode. A record found by two modes counts under both, so these need not sum to the include count. Count includes only — folding an `unsure` candidate in here credits a mode with work that is still unadjudicated.

unsure_by_mode.description: Optional. Candidates each mode surfaced that screened `unsure`. A mode whose only hits are unresolved did contribute recall, and that is worth separating from a mode that contributed nothing — dropping it is a different decision in each case.
